name: Dense graphs on 20 vertices without K2,3
description: construct() -> list of edges [u, v] of a simple graph on vertices 0..19 in which no two vertices have three common neighbours (no K2,3). Maximize the number of edges. A K2,3-free graph with m edges certifies ex(20;K2,3) >= m; the exact value for n = 20 is not documented here.

sources.locator: Zoltán Füredi, New Asymptotics for Bipartite Turán Numbers (1996). A K2,3-free graph with m edges certifies ex(20;K2,3) >= m; the exact value for n = 20 is not documented here.
